registered_bar.clause_2_note: e11 fell 0.0793. The clause assumed a damaged clip would have to ship, which stopped being true when per-clip adoption turned out to be legal on Tier 1. Recorded as failed rather than reinterpreted; see docs/T1_WARMSTART.md.

what_it_implies: The two adoptions add (0.3477 + 0.0625)/30 = +0.0137 to the 30-clip Tier 1 mean on their own.
